summary.en: Hell Ember pressures survivors with puppet teleport mobility and phantom double-hits, trading weak slow chase for very strong chair camping and map-wide puppet vision. He can easily Terror Shock greedy pallets and punishes teams that ignore puppets
summary.cn: 厂长靠傀儡传火与怨恨虚影进行多点施压，追击弱但守椅极强，傀儡可点亮附近求生者。他容易打出恐惧震慑，惩罚不拆娃、直线跑的队伍，怕前锋等强控拉扯。

summary.en: Smiley Face pressures survivors with rocket-dash mobility and burst dash hits, with modified drill adding anti-heal that greatly increases healing time. He is D-tier 10/35 Difficulty 1 and is countered by zig-zag windows that cut dashes off
summary.cn: 小丑靠火箭冲刺机动与冲刺 burst 压迫，直线追击强，改装钻头附带防愈，压受伤状态。他是 D 级新手监管，最怕之字形板窗拉扯与强控打断。

summary.en: Gamekeeper pressures survivors with long-range Chain Hook that deals 25% Fear and pulls for double-hits, plus traps and proxy camping that turn maps into zoning playgrounds. He partly counters Cowboy by dragging back and trap-blocking pallets
summary.cn: 鹿头靠钩子远程抓人、陷阱控场与守椅施压，能中断救援并把求生者拉回。他部分克制牛仔，怕灵活身位与祭司通道转点。

strugglesVs: tight cover loopers who block hooks

summary.en: The Ripper pressures survivors with invisibility and flying Fog Blades that strike at range and leave speed-boosting fog trails. Blockers like Seer and Perfumer are great counters as he cannot spam Freezing Fog, while Magician decoy also blocks Blade Mist
summary.cn: 杰克靠隐身接近与雾刃远程消耗，雾区加速让他转点与雾刃连击很强。他怕护盾式保人，被先知、调香、魔术师克制，欺负腿短与偷摸修机位。

summary.en: Soul Weaver pressures survivors with spittable webbing that deals 25% Fear and slows movement, shutting down pallet loops and forcing open kites to slice webs. Doctor is a good counter as she heals chip damage, while Knee Jerk and open routing stretch loops to 80+ seconds
summary.cn: 蜘蛛靠吐丝减速与 25% 芯丝伤害封锁板窗，逼求生者去空地清丝。医生能回芯片伤害，前锋、佣兵、祭司等机动救援位好应对，欺负腿短修机位。

summary.en: Geisha pressures survivors with incredibly fast dash mobility that punishes transitional kiting, buffed to 33/35 S-tier by the Nov 20 2025 hotfix. Eye contact interrupts her dash and Prospector magnets plus audio cues break her flow
summary.cn: 红蝶靠刹那生灭高机动追击，空地转点压迫极强，2025 年 11 月 20 日 hotfix 后回到 S 级。回头注视可打断飞魂，勘探磁铁与先知鸟克制，欺负盲女、机械等腿短位。

summary.en: The Feaster pressures survivors with summonable Tentacles that deal 50% Fear and enable double-hits, leveraging the largest attack range to zone pallets and chairs. Tentacles charge by absorbing Terror and can be released at range for map control
summary.cn: 黄衣之主靠触手远程控场与大攻击范围压板窗、守椅，能双击连招。他怕祭司通道与前锋打断、分散清触手，欺负园丁、盲女等慢速修机位。

summary.en: Wu Chang pressures survivors with Summon teleports that exert pressure on every part of the map and turn losses to wins, with White Guard chasing in open and Black Guard winning tight loops. Mercenary is his biggest counter by taking away combo options, while Frost lists him S-tier dual-form high ceiling
summary.cn: 宿伞之魂靠抛伞传送全图控机、双形态切换：白追空地、黑赢近战博弈，满存在感后救援与牵制都难。他最怕佣兵伤害延迟断连招，怕祭司、守墓地下室救援，欺负机械、咒术等短手位。

summary.en: Photographer pressures survivors through the Camera World that lasts about 60 seconds where he walks faster, forcing double-duty healing and decode drag. Doctor is a good counter as she heals the smallest mirror chip damage
summary.cn: 摄影师靠相中世界 60 秒双线施压，本体走得更快，逼全队补镜像伤害与修机。他怕医生秒补芯片、先知挡刀，欺负机械、囚徒、盲女等修机核心。

punishes: grouped survivors hit by mirror collapse
strugglesVs: aggressive rescuers who punish photo downtime

summary.en: Mad Eyes pressures survivors with distance-raised walls that block exits and routes, a Difficulty 3 map-control nightmare. Fences deal 25% Fear directly for double-hits, but Doctor counters chip by easily healing wall damage
summary.cn: 疯眼靠控制台全图划墙封路、分区控机，是难度 3 的控场型监管。围栏 25% 芯片伤害可双倒，怕医生回血、祭司通道绕墙，欺负机械、囚徒、盲女等站桩修机位。

summary.en: Dream Witch pressures survivors with followers that deny decodes across multiple areas, rated 35/35 S+ with 75% bans that crush escapes. Seer owls drag chases +20s plus group leech removal are the consensus answers
summary.cn: 梦之女巫靠多信徒全图控机、寄生跟随多线施压，35/35 S+ 常年 75% 禁用，运营与守椅都强。她怕抱团撕寄生、先知套鸟拖 20 秒、勘探磁铁，欺负机械、医生、盲女等修机与摸血体系。

summary.en: Axe Boy pressures survivors with throwable Resentful Souls that zone pallets and set up soul-plus-axe burst double-hits, sped by Restful Roads. Forward rugby-tackles him and Priestess stuns add +20s, while Perfumer cannot counter him easily
summary.cn: 爱哭鬼靠怨魂火封板窗、怨魂配斩双倒爆发，悔恨之路加速追击，近战博弈强。他怕前锋撞、祭司晕、先知鸟拖，欺负调香、盲女、机械等板窗与修机位。

summary.en: Evil Reptilian pressures survivors with multi-jumps that close open distance fast and Lethal Crash that deals damage without attack recovery. He punishes pallet-camping, standing decoders and slow rescues by crashing onto animations and destroying dropped pallets.
summary.cn: 孽蜥依靠多段跳快速拉近距离，并用致命坠击无擦刀造成范围伤害来施压。 他惩罚蹲板、站桩修机和救援动画，坠击可直接命中并破坏已放下的木板。

strugglesVs: tight indoor loopers on low-ceiling maps

summary.en: Bloody Queen pressures with Aqua Mirror that creates a Mirror Image to attack through walls and ignore loop geometry. She forces survivors out of safe loops and ends chases with long-range mirror slashes.
summary.cn: 红夫人依靠水镜生成镜像，无视地形在远距离出刀来施压。 她能把求生者逼出安全点位，用镜像封路并快速结束追击。

punishes: pallet and window loopers in low-wall areas
strugglesVs: high-wall dodgers who break mirror line

summary.en: Guard 26 pressures with timed remote bombs that chip, zone and chain for burst damage around ciphers and chairs. He is one of the hardest chair-campers, forcing rescuers to take damage to pull.
summary.cn: 26号守卫用定时遥控炸弹进行消耗、封走位和连锁爆发出伤，控场修机与守椅极强。 他守椅极难无伤救援，逼迫救人位吃炸弹强行拉人。

strugglesVs: long-distance dashers who force target swaps

summary.en: Disciple pressures with cats that reveal, latch and let her dash-stun survivors even through walls. She shuts down straight-line kiting and snowballs with leap-stun chase tempo.
summary.cn: 使徒用猫标记、吸附并突进眩晕，无视墙体快速追击施压。 她克制直线拉点，能用猫跳不断衔接追击节奏。

strugglesVs: multi-story abusers where cats cannot climb
magnet and push stunners who break dash

summary.en: Violinist pressures the whole map with strings that slow movement, decoding, healing and gate opening while stacking notes for instant damage. He controls cipher progress and punishes grouped or slow teams.
summary.cn: 小提琴家用琴弦全图减速修机、治疗和开门，并用音符叠加打出瞬间伤害。 他控场压修机节奏，惩罚抱团和腿短阵容。

strugglesVs: spread-out survivors who deny double notes

summary.en: Sculptor pressures with horizontal, vertical and homing statues that crush for half damage and block loops at range. She dominates narrow corridors and cipher triangles with versatile zone denial.
summary.cn: 雕刻家用横、纵及追踪雕像远程夹击造成伤害并封锁板窗博弈。 她在窄地形和三连机阵地控场极强，雕像组合几乎无死角。

summary.en: Undead pressures without chairs, downing to bleed out while immune to stuns in Energy Surge to ignore rescue tools. He punishes stun-reliant rescue comps and forces constant downs instead of chair tempo.
summary.cn: 博士不用狂欢之椅，靠击倒累积流血淘汰，并在能量涌动时免疫一切控制。 他惩罚依赖眩晕的救人体系，靠连续击倒滚雪球。

strugglesVs: tight loop kiters who drain energy

summary.en: Breaking Wheel pressures with wheel-form high-speed chase and human-form Pierce spikes that deal map-wide damage without attacking. He is stun-immune in wheel form and crushes small maps.
summary.cn: 破轮以轮形态高速追击，人形态用穿刺荆棘全图无刀气造成伤害。 轮形态免控，在小图追击和控场近乎无解。

summary.en: Naiad pressures with Abyss trails that stack Humidity to slow interactions and enable teleport hunts and burst. She traps survivors in water circles and punishes slow decoding rotations.
summary.cn: 渔女铺深渊水洼叠加湿气，减速交互并可瞬移追猎打出爆发。 她用水圈困住求生者，惩罚慢速修机与转点。

summary.en: Wax Artist pressures by spraying wax to slow movement and interactions, sealing windows and destroying pallets, then bursting with Molten Wax. His wax coat resists pallet stuns and splashes wax when stunned.
summary.cn: 蜡像师喷蜡减速并降低交互，封窗毁板后用热蜡油打出爆发击倒。 他自带蜡衣减控，被砸板反而溅射上蜡，极克制板窗博弈。

summary.en: Nightmare pressures with Spy vision and Ravens that reveal decoders, slow ciphers and allow teleport dives that auto-lock. He hunts hidden survivors but relies on early finds to snowball.
summary.cn: 噩梦用窥探标记和乌鸦找人、减速修机，并可瞬移飞扑自动锁定追击。 他抓藏猫修机位，但极依赖前期找到人滚节奏。

summary.en: Clerk pressures from any distance by recording moves and replaying attacks, heals and vaults while Invalid blocks key interactions. She inspects chairs from above and punishes healing and decoding near ciphers.
summary.cn: 记录员可录制动作并在任意距离回放出刀、治疗与翻窗，并用无效封锁关键交互。 她能俯视守椅，惩罚贴密码机修机与治疗行为。

summary.en: Hermit stalls ciphers with connected circuits and shares 1.2x attack damage across same-polarity survivors while stunning opposite-polarity survivors with electromagnetic fields. He teleports to Ball Lightning orbs for map pressure and two-shots damage-delay rescuers like Mercenary.
summary.cn: 隐士靠连通密码机拖慢破译，并用同极性分摊伤害与电磁场眩晕压制求生者。他能传送至闪电球转点，并靠高伤害克制佣兵等扛刀位。

strugglesVs: stealth survivors who avoid connected ciphers

summary.en: Night Watch chases with Tempest pulls and slows and Windwalk speed that lets him vault dropped pallets and windows without destroying them. At full presence he dashes across the map for pressure and yanks rescuers off chairs, excelling at pursuit and limiting survivor mobility.
summary.cn: 守夜人用风暴牵引减速留人，并靠风行快速翻越已放下木板和窗户追击。满存在后可用冲刺转点控场、拉开救人位，兼具追击与限制走位能力。

summary.en: Opera Singer cuts chases with Shadow Leap chains and speed boosts in Shadow Realms, leaving Remnants to teleport back for proxy camps. She must force vaults and breaks because she is slow at them and was severely nerfed in April 2025.
summary.cn: 歌剧演员靠影跃连跳与影域加速快速近身，并用残影回传守椅控场。她翻板翻窗与踩板慢，需逼迫交互，且2025年4月被大砍。

summary.en: Fool's Gold pressures with Unstable Ground that makes obstacles dangerous and collapses for half-attack chip damage. His 15-meter unstable zones collapse for 0.5x damage on throw or recall, letting him zone loops and camp chairs from range.
summary.cn: 愚人金用不稳定地面让板窗区变危险区，塌陷造成半普通攻击的碎血。其15米不稳定带可投掷或收回引爆，兼具封走位与远程守椅。

summary.en: The Shadow controls maps with Corrupted Ostracons and teleports to them while her fast Yithian infects survivors and reveals camera direction. At 100 Corruption survivors are puppeted toward her, giving her dangerous pursuit and great area control.
summary.cn: 时空之影用蚀骨片布场传送，伊斯人高速感染并窥视求生者朝向。侵蚀度满100会强制走向监管者，追击与控场极强。

summary.en: Goatman creates circular cages that teleport victims to the opposite side and must fight inside them, as outside attacks deal only half damage. He stalls rescues by caging rescuers away from chairs and is a must-ban in high tier with little counterplay.
summary.cn: 跛脚羊制造环形牢笼传送困住求生者，笼外伤害只有一半，必须在笼内作战。他能把救人位关在椅子范围外拖救人，高阶必ban难反制。

summary.en: Hullabaloo runs at 5.1 m/s with no hit recovery and must stack three different Fright marks to burst for normal-attack damage with Terror Shock. His stage disables items, slows movement and cripples vault and decode speed while Trapeze vaults over survivors and structures.
summary.cn: 喧嚣移速5.1且命中无擦刀，需叠三种惊吓标记引爆造成普攻伤害并恐惧震慑。其舞台禁道具、减速并减翻越破译速度，跳跃可翻越求生者与建筑。

summary.en: Peddler absorbs ground, obstacles and metal to place binding wither traps, open temporary wall passages and disable ciphers and chairs. She pulls herself up to 35m with vines and gains 40% control resistance plus range and speed from metal, making her highly adaptable.
summary.cn: 杂货商吸收地面、障碍与金属，布置束缚枯萎陷阱、开临时通道并瘫痪密码机椅子。她藤蔓最远35米位移，金属加成提供40%控制抵抗与移速攻击距离，极为全能。

summary.en: Cueist lays Contact Points to ride trajectories as Maxwell's Demon, ignoring collisions and teleporting along the path while gaining speed and revealing nearby survivors on exit. His Closed Domain scans reveal outlines and cut top cipher progress by 15% while Cue Balls capture and drag survivors to him from 8-11m.
summary.cn: 台球手布置触点形成轨迹，化身麦克斯韦妖无视碰撞位移传送，下线加速并透视附近求生者。封闭领域扫描透视并削减最高进度密码机15%，母球捕获后8-11米拖拽求生者。

strugglesVs: fast jukers who dodge cue ball

summary.en: Queen Bee sends a 15 m/s swarm up to 28m to drain energy and speed herself while chasing, making her an aggressive chase-focused hunter. She spends energy for 0.5x Stinger chip shots and flies to her swarm at any distance to proxy camp and build map pressure.
summary.cn: 女王蜂释放15米每秒、最远28米蜂群追踪回能加速，是强追击型监管。她用能量发射0.5倍毒刺碎血，并可全图飞回蜂群守椅控场。

strugglesVs: tight jukers who dodge stinger aim

summary.en: Dentist projects a 32m ultraviolet beam that chips for 0.5x without attack recovery and slides through walls, teleporting to its front with Dark Mire. His Phototherapy wall makes obstacles transparent and slows survivors, letting him camp from distance as a pursuit, camp and map-control hunter.
summary.cn: 牙医释放32米紫外光束，无擦刀造成0.5倍碎血并可滑过障碍，暗沼传送至光照前端。光疗之墙使障碍透明并减速，兼具追击守椅控场。

summary.en: Herztier, Emil's Patient hunter counterpart, is a dual-form switch pursuer built for relentless single-target pursuit. He hunts with hook-like mobility to run down kiters but currently leaks to cipher rush and looks weak in rank meta.
summary.cn: 心兽为病人埃米尔的监管形态，是双形态切换的执着单追型监管。他靠钩索机动咬住遛鬼位，但目前挡不住密码机 rush，排位偏弱。
